candidates.title: BLS Jobs by Industry Category
candidates.description: Data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Current Employment Statistics (CES) program. CES data represents businesses and government agencies, providing detailed industry data on employment on nonfarm payrolls.

candidates.title: Maryland Counties Socioeconomic Characteristics (ACS 5-Year Estimates 2024)
candidates.description:
The ACS 5-Year estimates are period estimates that describe the average characteristics of a population over the five-year data collection period (2020-2024). These data provide comprehensive information on the social, economic, housing, and demographic characteristics of the population in each of Maryland's county.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 American Community Survey, 5-Year Estimates

candidates.title: BLS Jobs Data - Change from the Previous Month
candidates.description: This dataset represents the CHANGE in the number of jobs per industry category and sub-category from the previous month, not the raw counts of actual jobs. The data behind these monthly change values is from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Current Employment Statistics (CES) program. CES data represents businesses and government agencies, providing detailed industry data on employment on nonfarm payrolls.

candidates.title: Annual Gross Domestic Product Maryland
candidates.description: This dataset contains Annual GDP using chained dollars from previous period by sector from 1997 to present (most recent as reported by U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis) for Maryland and United States.

candidates.title: Maryland Full And Part Time Jobs By Industry: 2010 to 2020
candidates.description:
Total Full and Part-Time Jobs in Maryland by Type and Industry from 2010 to 2020. Sourced from the U.S. BEA Table CAEMP25N.

Note: Statistical product has been discontinued due to budget and resource constraints.
